def compute_eigen(matrix, size):
    work = libgsl_eigen_hermv_workspace_alloc(size)
    eigenvalues = libgsl_vector_alloc(size)
    eigenvectors = libgsl_vector_alloc(size)
    
    # Convert complex matrix to GSL format
    mat_ptr = ctypes.pointer((ctypes.c_double * (size * size))())
    comp_num_ptr = ctypes.cast(mat_ptr, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.POINTER(gsl_complex)))
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            real = ctypes.c_double(matrix[i][j].real)
            imag = ctypes.c_double(matrix[i][j].imag)
            cnum = gsl_complex(real.value, imag.value)
            comp_num_ptr.contents[i * size + j] = ctypes.addressof(cnum)
    
    # Create a GSL matrix from the data
    mat = libgslcblas.gsl_matrix_complex_new(size, size)
    mat_data = (ctypes.c_double * (size * size))()
    for i in range(size):
        for j in range(size):
            mat_data[i * size + j] = cnum.real if i == j else 0.0
            comp_num_ptr.contents[i * size + j] = cnum
    
    # Set the data into the GSL matrix
    libgslcblas.gsl_matrix_complex_set(mat, size, size, mat_ptr)
    
    # Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors
    libgsl_eigen_hermv(mat, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, work)
    
    # Convert eigenvalues and eigenvectors back to Python format
    eigenvalues_list = []
    eigenvectors_list = [[0.0j] * size for _ in range(size)]

        real = ctypes.c_double(eigenvalues.contents.data[i].real)

        eigenvalues_list.append(complex(real.value, imag.value))
        for j in range(size):
            real = ctypes.c_double(eigenvectors.contents.data[j * size + i].real)
            imag = ctypes.c_double(eigenvectors.contents.data[j * size + i].imag)
            eigenvectors_list[j][i] = complex(real.value, imag.value)
    
    # Free memory

    libgsl_vector_free(eigenvalues)
    libgsl_vector_free(eigenvectors)
    libgsl_eigen_hermv_workspace_free(work)

    # Convert complex list to array of doubles
    real_parts = [z.real for z in complex_list[::incX]]
    imag_parts = [z.imag for z in complex_list[::incX]]

    for i in range(len(abscissae)):
